tasks.label: lint:ps
args: $results = @('download.ps1','makeyaml.ps1','movefile.ps1','normalize.ps1','favorite.ps1','fakerank.ps1') | ForEach-Object { Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $_ -Settings .vscode/PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1 }; foreach ($item in $results) { $line = if ($item.Line) { $item.Line } else { 1 }; $column = if ($item.Column) { $item.Column } else { 1 }; "$($item.ScriptPath):${line}:${column}: $($item.Severity): $($item.RuleName): $($item.Message)" }; if ($results | Where-Object Severity -eq 'Error') { exit 1 }
